# 8. Properly use LOOC during the round.
You are encouraged to use LOOC during rounds to provide assistance or ask questions to other players. LOOC is never to be used to attack or antagonize others. Please do not use LOOC during rounds to discuss topics that would be better suited for Discord or post-round conversation, as it can distract or detract from the RP experience of other players.
If you see a message in LOOC regarding spoilers for the round, such as information pertaining to a character’s antagonist status, you are encouraged to not metagame as your character. Remember to separate your knowledge from character’s knowledge.
You may see people you recognize from videos, while saying “Hi, I love your videos! \<3” in LOOC is very sweet, it’s encouraged to save messages like that for post-round OOC.
## Allowed - “Something is happening IRL and I need to go SSD for a bit, sorry!” - “I can’t find the button to open the menu I’m trying to use.” - “Sorry need to restart my game, brb.”
## Not Allowed - “Hi YouTuber, I love your videos! \<3” Comments like this can be sweet, but should be saved for post-round OOC chat. - “Ordering Taco Bell. Chicken or beef?” LOOC is not intended for casual chatting. - “Your character is such a badass.” Compliments are sweet, but belong in post-round OOC chat. - “Can you shut the fuck up?” If a player is being disruptive, ahelp them; OOC chats are not the place to vent your frustrations.
